title: Te Kaikaranga Tuturu ki te Pono
intro: E tū ana te karere i waenganui i te iwi pakeke, e karanga ana i a rātou ki te Atua Pono Kotahi, engari e piri tonu ana rātou ki ngā whakapakoko teka. He ingoa kaha tō tēnei poropiti—'ko te tangata e rapu ana i te tiakitanga'—engari ko te whakahē me te whakakāhoretanga anake ka riro mai i a ia. Mā te whakatenatena ngawari me te whakatūpato pakari, ka haria e tēnei wairua he karere atua ka whakatikahia e te ao whānui. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata pumau e tohu ana i tētahi o ngā kōrero tawhito rawa atu i roto i ngā karaipiture Ihirama?
clues: He maha ngā atua i karakia ai tōku iwi, ko ahau ia i karanga i a rātou ki te mahi ki te Kaihanga o te rangi me te whenua.
I tū ahau i mua i tōku iwi, ka kī atu kāore au e rapu utu i a rātou—ko tāku anake i hiahia ai ko tā rātou ārahi ki te tika.
I tukuna mai he hau nui ki runga i tōku iwi hei whiu atua, he hau e kōrerotia ana i roto i te Quran i roto i ngā āhua maha me ngā āhua wahine.
Kāore i rite ki ētahi poropiti, kāore i hoatu he wahine, he tamariki rānei ki ahau i whakahuatia nuitia i roto i taku kōrero, nā te mea ko taku misioni he karanga i tōku iwi kia huihui mai rātou.
He tikanga hohonu tōku ingoa—e pā ana ki te ariā o te tiakitanga me te piringa e rapua ana e te tangata.
I mōhiotia tōku iwi ki tētahi kupu whenua motuhake mō te awaawa i nohoia e rātou, ā, i whakaahuatia tō rātou whenua me te tino whakahawea mō te kore o ngā otaota.
